## Setup

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r paths}
processed_dir <- file.path("output", "01_processing_subset_to_HPC")
out_dir <- file.path("output", "02_Integration_clustering")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

rds_files <- list.files(processed_dir, pattern = "_QC_hippocampus\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
sample_names <- gsub("_QC_hippocampus\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))
names(rds_files) <- sample_names

rds_files
```

## Load all processed samples

```{r load-samples}
seurat_list <- map(rds_files, readRDS)
```

## Normalize each sample individually (SCTransform)

Run SCTransform per sample *before* merging — this keeps each sample's variance stabilization
appropriate to its own sequencing depth, which is important for young/middle/old comparison.

```{r sctransform, warning=FALSE}
seurat_list <- map(seurat_list, function(sp_obj) {
  SCTransform(sp_obj, assay = "Spatial", verbose = FALSE)
})
```

## Merge all samples into one object

```{r merge}
merged_obj <- merge(
  x = seurat_list[[1]],
  y = seurat_list[-1],
  add.cell.ids = names(seurat_list)
)

# carry over the correct variable features from SCT across all samples
VariableFeatures(merged_obj) <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(seurat_list, nfeatures = 3000)

names(merged_obj@images) <- names(seurat_list)
```

## PCA, then Harmony integration across samples

Important to correct for batch effects, we integrate on `sample` before finding clusters

```{r pca-harmony}
merged_obj <- RunPCA(merged_obj, assay = "SCT", npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

merged_obj <- RunHarmony(
  merged_obj,
  group.by.vars = "sample",
  assay.use = "SCT",
  reduction.use = "pca",
  reduction.save = "harmony"
)
```

## Clustering and UMAP on the integrated embedding

```{r clustering}
merged_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

merged_obj <- FindClusters(merged_obj, resolution = 0.15)

merged_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
```

```{r umap-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(merged_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Clusters across all samples")

DimPlot(merged_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "age") +
  ggtitle("Colored by age - check clusters aren't just splitting by age")

# rename clusters
merged_obj$region <- dplyr::case_when(
  merged_obj$seurat_clusters == "0" ~ "ML",
  merged_obj$seurat_clusters == "1" ~ "CA1_2",
  merged_obj$seurat_clusters == "2" ~ "CA3",
  merged_obj$seurat_clusters == "3" ~ "DG",
  TRUE ~ as.character(merged_obj$seurat_clusters)
)

DimPlot(merged_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "region") +
  ggtitle("Colored by region")


merged_obj$region <- factor(merged_obj$region)

table(merged_obj$region)
```

## Visualize clusters spatially per sample

This is a check if clustering worked well

```{r spatial-cluster-plots, fig.width=6, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE}
for (sample_name in names(seurat_list)) {
  sub_obj <- subset(merged_obj, subset = sample == sample_name)
  print(
    SpatialDimPlot(sub_obj, label = TRUE, label.size = 3, group.by = "region") +
      ggtitle(sample_name)
  )
}
```

## Check known hippocampal region markers directly

Cross-reference clusters against canonical markers

```{r known-markers, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
region_markers <- c(
  "Prox1",   # granule cell layer (GCL)
  "Dcx",     # immature neurons / neurogenic lineage
  "Gfap",    # astrocytes, often enriched near molecular layer / SGZ
  "Wfs1",    # CA1 pyramidal (if present)
  "Neurod6"  # broad excitatory neuron marker
)

present_markers <- intersect(region_markers, rownames(merged_obj))

FeaturePlot(merged_obj, features = present_markers, reduction = "umap")
```

## Save the merged, clustered object

```{r save}
saveRDS(merged_obj, file.path(out_dir, "merged_hippocampus_clustered.rds"))
```
